mismatches.question: Do I have to pay an excess on every claim?
mismatches.rationale: p.21 shows an excess applies to most sections but not to those marked with an asterisk.

mismatches.question: Is personal liability cover provided for all sports and activities?
mismatches.rationale: p.16 excludes Personal Liability cover for asterisked sports/activities.

mismatches.question: Is a pre-existing medical condition covered?
mismatches.rationale: p.15 excludes pre-existing medical conditions unless screened and agreed.

mismatches.question: If I have to cancel my trip, is that covered?
mismatches.rationale: p.21 lists Cancellation or Cutting Short your Trip as a covered section with limits.
